content.text: Image point coordinates are in [y, x] format, where y is the vertical axis, x is the horizontal axis; their values are normalized from 0 to 1000, where [0 0] is the top left, [1000 1000] is the bottom right. What object is located immediately to the right of point [710 991] in the second image, just outside of the frame? Choices: A. yellow vacuum cleaner. B. wooden table. C. couch. D. TV. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
